paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Misiangloute
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante agiahna mun ua kipan phak tengteng leh sipawt tengteng leh misi ziak a buah peuhmahte pawtkhesak vek ding in thu pia in.
english: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, and everyone who has an issue, and whoever is unclean by the dead.

paite: Numei leh pasal pawtkhesak in giahphual pua ah na koih ding ahi. Alaitak a ka omna giahna mun abuahsaklouhna ding un," achi hi.
english: Both you shall put male and female outside of the camp; that they not defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”

paite: Huchi in Israel suante'n huchibang in ahih uhi, dainawl ah akoihkhia ua; TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a agen bang in Israel suante'n ahih uhi.
english: The children of Israel did so, and put them out outside of the camp; as Yahweh spoke to Moses, so did the children of Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Hihdik Louhte Ditkik Nawnna
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah gen inla, pasal hiam, numei hiam in TOUPA tung ah thil bangpeuh na hihkhial in moh taleh;
english: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Yahweh, and that soul is guilty;

paite: ahihkhelhna ah thupha atawi ding ahi. Ahihkhelh man pen kimtak in adin dia, amun nga a khen mun khat ahihkhelhnapa apiak behlap ding ahi.
english: then he shall confess his sin which he has done, and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, and add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.

paite: Himahleh huai mi in khelh man piakna ding tanau nai aneih keileh, khelh man pen TOUPA a tuam ahi dia, akhelh man leh akhialpa a dia kilemna bawlsakna belampa pen siampu kiang a piak ding ahi.
english: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to Yahweh shall be the priest’s; besides the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.

paite: Israel suante thil siangthou vei thillat tengteng, siampu kiang a lat peuhmah siampu a tuam ding ahi.
english: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.

paite: Michih thil siangthou siampu a tuam ahi dia, mite'n siampu apiak peuhmah ama a tuam ahi ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: Every man’s holy things shall be his: whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Pasalte Muanmoh Zite Thubuaite
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah gen inla, akiang uah, Mi, azi in alampialsan a, mi'n amah kithuahpih henla, apasal in thei kei henla,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray, and is unfaithful to him,

paite: huchibang a a-om nilouh a, kihihthanghuai pipi a kigenkhe nai lou hi in, athei kuamah om lou, mat louh hitaleh;
english: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and is kept close, and she is defiled, and there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;

paite: apasal thikthu hong sia a, azi muangmoh a, siangthou lou mah ana hihleh, ahihkeileh apasal thikthu hong sia a, azi muangmoh a, azi siangthou ana hihleh:
english: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife, and she is defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife, and she isn’t defiled:

paite: huai mi in azi a dia thillat barli buh tangbuang ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat tawi in siampu kiang ah azi api ding hi. Athillat ding sathau abuak ding ahi kei a, begaw leng anuh ding ahi sam kei. Thikthusiatna tangbuang thillat, theihgigena thillat, thulimlouhna theihgigena ahi.
english: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: the tenth part of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.

paite: "Siampu in azi api dia, TOUPA ma ah adingsak dia:
english: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before Yahweh;

paite: Siampu in leibel in tui siangthou ala dia, biakbuk pialkhang a leivui ala dia, tui ah akhe ding hi.
english: and the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water.

paite: Siampu in huai numei TOUPA ma ah adingsak dia, asam akhahkhiaksak dia, theihgigena tangbuang thillat atawisak dia; siampu in hamsia tungsak tui kha akhut in atawi ding,
english: The priest shall set the woman before Yahweh, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.

paite: Siampu in huai numei akichiamsak dia, numei kiang ah, 'Na pasal hilou midang kuamah in hon kithuahpih louh a, nitna lam a na lampial keileh hamsia tungsak hiai tui kha a pan na hul ding.
english: The priest shall cause her to swear, and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.

paite: Himahleh lampialsan a na kihihnit a, na pasal lou mi kuahiam in ahon kithuahpihleh na hul kei ding,' achi ding.
english: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband:”

paite: Siampu in numei avau dia, akichiamsak ding. Numei kiang ah siampu in, 'TOUPA'N na pheipi azawtsak a, na gil apuaksakleh, TOUPA'N na chipihte lak ah hamsethuak in nang hon bawl hen.
english: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “Yahweh make you a curse and an oath among your people, when Yahweh allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;

paite: Hamsia tungsak hiai tui na gil ah alut dia, na gil apuaksak dia, na pheipi azawsak ding. Numei in, Amen, Amen,' achi ding.
english: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”

paite: "Siampu in huai hamsia thute laibu ah agelh dia, tui kha ah adiah ding hi.
english: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out into the water of bitterness.

paite: Hamsia tungsak tui kha numei adawnsak ding ahi. Huchi in hamsia tungsak tui kha agilsung ah alut dia, ahong kha ding hi.
english: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.

paite: Siampu in thikthusiatna thillat tangbuang numei khut a pan ala dia; TOUPA ma ah tangbuang thillat avei dia, maitam ah apaipih ding hi.
english: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before Yahweh, and bring it to the altar.

paite: Siampu in tangbuang thillat theihgigena pham khat ala dia, maitam ah ahal dia, huai khit in tui numei adawnsak ding ahi.
english: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

paite: Tui adawnsakleh hichi ahi dia; ahong nit a, apasal tung a thil hihkhial ana hihleh hamsia tungsak huai tui agilsung ah alut dia, ahong kha dia, agil ahong puak dia, apheipi ahong zaw dia; huchi in numei achipihte lak a hamsia thuaknu ahong hi ding hi.
english: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled, and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away: and the woman will be a curse among her people.

paite: Himahleh numei anit louh a, asianthouleh ahul dia, nau apai thei ding.
english: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

paite: "Hiai zi lampial a, apasal hilou midang toh kihihnin hiam,
english: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled;

paite: ahihkeileh apasal thikthu hong siat a azi ahazat chiang a vaihawmdan ding ahi. Huchi in TOUPA ma ah api dia, siampu in hiai dan tengteng bang in atung ah ahih ding.
english: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before Yahweh, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.

paite: Huchi in pasal pen thulimlouhna ah ahul dia, numei in akhelhna moh apo ding hi, chi in," achi hi.
english: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”
